# Packaging

## Icons — Source of truth: `dist/logo.png`

All app icon assets are auto-derived from `dist/logo.png` by a single script:

```sh
python3 scripts/gen-icons.py
```

Requires **Pillow** (`pip install pillow`). The outputs are committed so CI never
needs Python at build time — re-run only when `dist/logo.png` changes.

Outputs:

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `dist/komet.png` | 1024×1024 RGBA squircle — Linux UI window icon, tarball, AppImage |
| `dist/macos/icon-1024.png` | 1024×1024 RGBA squircle, Apple HIG margins + drop shadow → `.icns` |
| `dist/windows/komet.ico` | Multi-res ICO (16–256 px, alpha) embedded into `.exe` via `build.rs` |
| `dist/icons/hicolor/<n>x<n>/apps/komet.png` | Standard XDG hicolor sizes (16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024) |

---

## Linux (implemented)

```sh
scripts/package-linux.sh            # release build (thin LTO, stripped)
PROFILE=debug scripts/package-linux.sh   # fast smoke package
```

Produces `target/package/komet-<version>-linux-<arch>.tar.gz` containing:

- `komet` — the binary (stripped)
- `komet.desktop` — XDG desktop entry
- `komet.png` — 1024×1024 app icon (RGBA squircle)
- `icons/hicolor/` — full XDG icon hierarchy (16 → 1024 px)
- `install.sh` — installs into `~/.local/{bin,share/applications,share/icons}`

### AppImage

```sh
scripts/package-appimage.sh
```

Produces `target/package/komet-<version>-linux-<arch>.AppImage`.
Embeds the full hicolor icon set (used by AppImageLauncher, Dolphin, etc.).

### Debian / Ubuntu (`.deb`)

```sh
scripts/package-deb.sh
PROFILE=debug scripts/package-deb.sh
```

Produces `target/package/komet_<version>_<arch>.deb`. Binary is stripped.
Uses `dpkg-deb` if available, otherwise assembles via standard `ar`+`tar`
(works on any Linux without dpkg installed). Includes `postinst`/`postrm` hooks
that run `update-desktop-database` and `gtk-update-icon-cache`.

### Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE (`.rpm`)

```sh
scripts/package-rpm.sh
PROFILE=debug scripts/package-rpm.sh
```

Produces `target/package/komet-<version>-1.<dist>.<arch>.rpm`.
Requires `rpmbuild` (install via `dnf install rpm-build`).
The spec is generated dynamically at packaging time.

---

## macOS

```sh
scripts/package-macos.sh    # → target/package/komet-<version>-macos-<arch>.dmg
```

Builds the release binary, assembles `Komet.app` (Info.plist + icns), ad-hoc
signs it (set `CODESIGN_IDENTITY` for a real Developer ID), and wraps it in a
dmg. The auto-update tarball retains an internal `Komet.app` path so older
installed builds can update into Komet. CI runs this on tags
(`.github/workflows/release.yml`). The manual steps it automates, for reference
(run on a macOS host — gpui needs Metal; no cross-build from Linux):

1. Build the universal (or per-arch) binary:
   ```sh
   cargo build --release -p komet --target aarch64-apple-darwin
   cargo build --release -p komet --target x86_64-apple-darwin
   lipo -create -output komet \
     target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/komet \
     target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/komet
   ```
2. Assemble the bundle:
   ```sh
   mkdir -p Komet.app/Contents/{MacOS,Resources}
   cp komet Komet.app/Contents/MacOS/komet
   sed "s/__VERSION__/$(grep -m1 '^version' Cargo.toml | sed 's/.*"\(.*\)".*/\1/')/" \
     dist/macos/Info.plist > Komet.app/Contents/Info.plist
   ```
3. Icon — `dist/macos/icon-1024.png` (Apple HIG squircle with margins and
   drop shadow, generated by `scripts/gen-icons.py`):
   ```sh
   mkdir komet.iconset
   for sz in 16 32 128 256 512; do
     sips -z $sz $sz dist/macos/icon-1024.png --out komet.iconset/icon_${sz}x${sz}.png
     sips -z $((sz*2)) $((sz*2)) dist/macos/icon-1024.png --out komet.iconset/icon_${sz}x${sz}@2x.png
   done
   iconutil -c icns komet.iconset -o Komet.app/Contents/Resources/komet.icns
   ```
4. Sign + notarize (required for distribution):
   ```sh
   codesign --deep --force --options runtime --sign "Developer ID Application: …" Komet.app
   xcrun notarytool submit Komet.zip --keychain-profile … --wait
   xcrun stapler staple Komet.app
   ```
5. Ship as a `.dmg` (`hdiutil create -volname Komet -srcfolder Komet.app -ov -format UDZO Komet.dmg`).

---

## Windows

```sh
scripts/package-windows.sh
# → target/package/komet-<version>-windows-x86_64.zip
# → target/package/komet-<version>-windows-x86_64.exe (portable)
```

The `.ico` embedded inside the `.exe` is compiled at build time via
`apps/komet/build.rs` (`winres`) from `dist/windows/komet.ico`.
The `.ico` is a multi-resolution file (16–256 px) with alpha channel generated
by `scripts/gen-icons.py`. Run `cargo clean -p komet` before rebuilding if
you updated the `.ico` to avoid the incremental cache keeping the old icon.
